limits: This approves the bounded v2 export method before execution; it does not certify that Git succeeds or any new interface has the detector shape.
Prior-source exclusion is restricted to the audited local records. A missing SHA reference does not establish global blindness; historical fixed-500 model calls may have seen materials.
cat-file -p preserves the entire raw commit object, including its message. The exporter parses only the header and suppresses message display/interpretation; this is not complete message sealing.
Metadata endianness words and optional count words are only selection signals, not a ground-truth relevance label or evidence of a length contract.

The first changed C and first two physical-line quoted include prefixes are a deliberately narrow extraction. No C, missing files or absence of a declaration is extraction/support insufficiency, never a false negative or true negative.

The quote scanner accepts trailing comments but is not a preprocessor; multiline directives, macro-expanded includes, comments before directives, inactive branches, generated headers and global search resolution are not certified.
Observed lexical source order is not CFG order or first dynamic use. Macro/alias/producer/type/revision ambiguity must remain conditional.
Detector-shape support and complete source-gate authority are distinct. A standard header cannot be substituted if the fixed files lack the actual declaration chain.

No detector or source gate runs, patch unsealing, compiler/kernel/hardware, project model calls or network are authorized by this audit. Positive/negative accuracy and new confirmed defects remain zero.
reviewed_diff: Only trailing-comment literal-prefix parsing plus v2 freeze/review identity binding. Metadata/queue/command and file limits are unchanged.
